passage.text: Last Friday night, Nam and Emma were watching a movie in their apartment.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈnaɪt, ˈnɑːm ənd ˈɛmə wɜːr ˈwɑːtʃɪŋ ə ˈmuːvi ɪn ðɛr əˈpɑːrtmənt.

passage.text: Suddenly, the lights went out, and the building was in darkness.
passage.reading: ˈsʌdənli, ðə ˈlaɪts ˈwɛnt ˈaʊt, ənd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ wʌz ɪn ˈdɑːrknəs.

passage.text: Then they heard someone scream in the hall.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ðeɪ ˈhɜːrd ˈsʌmwʌn ˈskriːm ɪn ðə ˈhɔːl.

passage.text: "Don't panic," Nam said. "It's just a power outage."
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈpænɪk, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛd. ɪts dʒʌst ə ˈpaʊər ˌaʊtɪdʒ.

passage.text: She found a flashlight in the kitchen, and they went out into the hall.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈfaʊnd ə ˈflæʃlaɪt ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən, ənd ðeɪ ˈwɛnt ˈaʊt ɪntə ðə ˈhɔːl.

passage.text: There were a lot of people in the hall.
passage.reading: ðɛr wɜːr ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpiːpəl ɪn ðə ˈhɔːl.

passage.text: A little girl was crying because she was scared of the dark.
passage.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɡɜːrl wʌz ˈkraɪɪŋ bɪˈkɔːz ʃiː wʌz ˈskɛrd əv ðə ˈdɑːrk.

passage.text: Emma gave her a cookie, and Nam stayed with her.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə ˈɡeɪv hɜːr ə ˈkʊki, ənd ˈnɑːm ˈsteɪd wɪð hɜːr.

passage.text: After twenty minutes, the lights came back on.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts, ðə ˈlaɪts ˈkeɪm ˈbæk ˈɑːn.

passage.text: Everyone laughed and went back to their apartments.
passage.reading: ˈɛvriwʌn ˈlæft ənd ˈwɛnt ˈbæk tə ðɛr əˈpɑːrtmənts.

passage.text: "Next time, let's buy more flashlights," Nam said.
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm, ˈlɛts ˈbaɪ ˈmɔːr ˈflæʃlaɪts, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛd.
